breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly removed the erroneous instruction to 'superpose M_y z / I_y and M_z y / I_z as though the product of inertia were zero'. The generated specification, like the ground truth, now correctly implies that the full unsymmetric bending formula should be used with all given values, including the non-zero product of inertia (Iyz).
